limitations: This is fresh-prefix reproduction on the existing WSL host, not a second physical machine or every OS/architecture.
The lock fixes the selected Python dependency graph and hashes; native client archives, OS/interpreter, npm packages, models and services retain separate recipes and acceptance.
The initial install used local uv cache; the subsequent --no-cache --reinstall fetched all36 packages and passed required hashes with source builds disabled.
Hash matching and dependency compatibility do not establish build provenance, vulnerability freedom or model quality.
Preflight checks presence and recipe paths only; it does not execute tools, inspect configuration, authenticate, probe services or prove runtime E2E.

Initial native account inspection required authentication; native sign-in restored readiness. This SDK setup receipt has no model inference; the later paired runtime has separate evidence and complete usage categories.
Existing account/service/environment configuration was not copied or replaced. Client discovery, optional GPU serving, off-host recovery and unattended hosting require their own target-host evidence.
